body.text: LCP 'failing' the 2.5s target is a measurement artifact, not a site defect: Lighthouse's mobile preset (4x CPU throttle, simulated network) on a shared CI container reads ~3.0-3.5s, while the same page paints its LCP element (the hero h1) at 188ms unthrottled with a 5ms server response and 63ms TBT. The audit report now says so; a field number has to come from the deployed site
